name: Argentina

nationalGame.name: Pato
nationalGame.about: Pato — a wild mix of basketball on horseback — is Argentina's official national game.

loved.name: Football
loved.why: Home of Messi and Maradona — football is a way of life here.

loved.name: Basketball
loved.why: Argentina beat the mighty USA team on the way to Olympic gold in 2004.

loved.name: Pato
loved.why: Cowboys on horseback still play it in the countryside.

fact: Pato has been played on the pampas since the 1600s — riders lean from galloping horses to drop a ball into a tall basket.
